Aluminium foil.disposal: Clean the foil and place it in the metal recycling stream if accepted.

Bottle cap.disposal: Collect separately and place in plastic recycling where accepted.

Bottle.disposal: Empty and place in the plastic recycling bin.

Broken glass.disposal: Handle carefully and dispose according to the local safety guidelines.

Can.disposal: Empty and place in the metal recycling bin.

Carton.disposal: Flatten and place in paper or cardboard recycling.

Cup.disposal: Check the material and local recycling rules before disposal.

Lid.disposal: Place in plastic recycling if accepted locally.

Other litter.disposal: Inspect the material and dispose according to local waste guidelines.

Other plastic.disposal: Place in the appropriate plastic recycling stream if accepted locally.

Paper.disposal: Place clean and dry paper in paper recycling.

Plastic bag - wrapper.disposal: Use a flexible-plastic collection point if available, otherwise follow local disposal rules.

Plastic container.disposal: Empty and place in the plastic recycling bin.

Pop tab.disposal: Place in the metal recycling stream.

Straw.disposal: Dispose according to local general waste guidance.

Styrofoam piece.disposal: Use a dedicated foam collection service if available.

Unlabeled litter.disposal: Manual inspection is recommended before disposal.
